title: Implement remaining internal functions (process-inbox, embed-doc, query-memory)
description:
Implement python3-http handlers for:
- process-inbox: Routes inbox entries to both Mem0 (facts) AND document_store (embeddings). Uses 'target' column for future routing flexibility.
- embed-doc: Chunks text, calls embedding provider (configurable: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small or Ollama nomic-embed-text), stores 768-dim vectors in document_store.
- query-memory: Queries both Mem0 API + document_store semantic search, merges results.

Config: Use embedding settings from infra/k8s/values/common.yaml (provider, model, dimension).

title: Test end-to-end local deployment
description:
Deploy to local k3d and verify core pipeline:
1. Start k3d cluster (k3d/local.yaml)
2. Deploy PostgreSQL + MinIO + OpenFaaS via helmfile
3. Apply init-db.sql schema (768-dim vectors, HNSW index, target column)
4. Deploy Mem0 (manifests/mem0.yaml)
5. Optional: Deploy Ollama (manifests/ollama.yaml) if embedding.ollama.enabled=true
6. Deploy add-memory function
7. Test: POST to add-memory endpoint, verify inbox table populated
8. Check logs for any errors

Note: Only testing add-memory initially - other functions come in nc7.
